questions_hin.q_hi: Which of the following is the possible code for “up side”?
questions_hin.s_hi:
“so many mornings” is coded as “aws drf njm”----------(i)

“woke up confused” is coded as “cfv bhn kol”-----------(ii)

“dreams are many” is coded as “zsx njm ytr”------------(iii)

“confused so are” is coded as “kol zsx drf”--------------(iv)

From equations (i) and (iii), we get that,

many → njm

From equations (i) and (iv), we get that,

so → drf

From equation (i), we get that,

mornings → aws

From equation (ii), we get that,

Woke/up → cfv/bhn

From equations (ii) and (iv), we get that,

confused → kol

From equations (iii) and (iv), we get that,

are → zsx

From equations (iv), we get that,

Dreams → ytr

The code for “up” is either “cfv/bhn” and “side” code must be unique.

questions_hin.q_hi: 11. एक निश्चित कूट भाषा में, "play in the sunshine" को "sh ko zm fq" के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है और "the sunshine is bright" को "ko sh gp rs" के रूप में कूटबद्ध किया जाता है। उस भाषा में "sunshine" के लिए संभावित कूट क्या है?
questions_hin.s_hi:
11.(d) ‘play in the sunshine’ → ‘sh ko zm fq’ ……….. (i)
‘the sunshine is bright’ → ‘ko sh gp rs’ ………… (ii)
समीकरण (i) और (ii) में, ‘the sunshine’ उभयनिष्ठ है और कोड ‘ko sh’ भी उभयनिष्ठ है.
तो, "sunshine’ का कोड "या तो ko या sh" है।
